🕴️ Pose: Slight Head Tilt
A subtle tilt of the head — curious, listening, or gently questioning. A small expressive shift.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Slight Head Tilt.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, keep the body relaxed and stable while tilting the head a few degrees to one side. Preserve the selected gaze, expression, camera angle, and crop. Female: the tilt carries through a long neck, shoulders soft. Male: the tilt carries against a set neck, shoulders level. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own neck.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
